An atom at the corner of a cube is shared among 8 unit cells. As there are 8 corners in a cube, number of corner
atom $\left(A\right)$ per unit cell $8 \times \dfrac{1}{8} = 1$
Face-centred atom in a cube is shared by two unit cells.
As there are 6 faces in a cube, number of face-centred
atom $\left(B\right)$ per unit cell $6 \times \dfrac{1}{2} = 3$
An atom in the body of the cube is not shared by other cells.
$∴$ Number of atoms $\left(C\right)$ at the body centre per unit cell = 1.
Hence, the formula of the solid is $A{B}_{3}C$ .

Number of X ions $= \dfrac{2n}{5}$
Number of Y ions $= \dfrac{n}{2}$
$\left\begin{array}{ll}\text{X}\text{:}\text{Y}\text{:}\text{O} \\ \dfrac{\text{2n}}{5} \text{:}\dfrac{n}{2} \text{:}\text{n} \\ \text{4}\text{:}\text{5}\text{:}\text{10}\end{array}\right\}$
Simplest formula $= {X}_{4}{Y}_{5}{O}_{10}$ .

questions.q: A metallic element crystallizes into a lattice containing a sequence layers of ABABAB ..... . Any packing of spheres leaves out voids in the lattice. What percentage by volume of this lattice is empty space?
questions.solution:
Packing fraction in hcp $= \dfrac{6 \times \dfrac{4}{3}\pi{r}^{3}}{Volume}$

$= \dfrac{6 \times 4\pi{r}^{3}}{3 \times Area \times Height}$

Area (of base) of unit cell in hcp $= 6\sqrt{3}{r}^{2}$ (follow text)

height of unit cell in hcp $= 4r \times \sqrt{\dfrac{2}{3}}$ (follow text)

So packing fraction $= \dfrac{6 \times 4\pi{r}^{3}}{3 \times 6\sqrt{3}{r}^{2} \times 4r \times \sqrt{\dfrac{2}{3}}}$

$= \dfrac{\pi}{3\sqrt{2}} = 0.74$

or = 74%

Thus, empty space in hcp = 1 - 0.74 = 0.26

or = 26%.

questions.q: In a solid 'XY' having the NaCl structure, 'X' atoms occupy the corners of the cubic unit cell. If all the face centred atoms along one of the axes are removed, then the resultant stiochiometry of the solid is found to be ${X}_{m}{Y}_{n}$ . Find the sum of m + n?
questions.solution:
Na in NaCl has eight corner and six face atoms and thus, if we remove face centred atom of one axis, then two faces atoms are removed. Thus, X is at 8 corners and Y is at 4 faces.
Number of X atoms per unit cell $= 8 \times \dfrac{1}{8} + 4 \times \dfrac{1}{2} = 3$
Number of Y atoms per unit cell $= 12 \times \dfrac{1}{4} + 1 = 4$
Thus, formula is ${X}_{3}{Y}_{4}$ .
Hence, m = 3, n = 4
sum of m + n = 3 + 4 = 7.
